subject: Pilot activation & PO gating for NovaCorp multi-division pilot
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novacorp.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot activation & PO gating for NovaCorp multi-division pilot

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency + cost profile. We're ready to kick off a multi-division pilot (Security, Analytics, Platform teams) but procurement and legal have a few gating items before we can issue a private offer/PO via AWS Marketplace.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood issue an AWS Marketplace Private Offer that covers a 3-month pilot with an optional 9-month conversion to an annual commitment? Procurement prefers a short pilot window but finance wants clarity on conversion/proration.
- We need the standard evidence pack (SOC 2 summary, data residency statement, network/VPC diagram) to start our security review.
- Procurement would like a PO template that maps to a 3->12 month conversion (so they can pre-approve CFO signoff routes).
- Are there co-sell credits or marketplace incentives we should plan for? We may include AWS co-sell for go-to-market alignment.

Could you loop in whoever manages marketplace activations & private-offer ops? Our procurement lead (Paul Tan, cc'd on future threads) will coordinate purchase orders. Ideally we'd have a mutual action plan this week so legal can start the review.

Attachments: sample_scope.pdf (mock), current_architecture-overview.png (mock)

Thanks,
Alicia Moreno
Head of Platform Integrations, NovaCorp
Alicia.Moreno@novacorp.com

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: "vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com", "Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novacorp.com>"
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot activation & PO gating for NovaCorp multi-division pilot

Thanks Alicia — great to hear the team is ready. Looping Vanessa and Marcus to own marketplace activation and pricing structure. Quick response with proposed path: 

1) Private Offer structure
   - Create an AWS Marketplace Private Offer scoped to the pilot: 3-month pilot term with a defined conversion option to 12 months. We can include an automatic proration clause so the conversion date aligns to the pilot end.
   - If NovaCorp wants to pre-authorize conversion (finance route), we can add a CFO signature step into the MSP workflow or provide a PO template that notes conversion terms.

2) Approvals & buyer matrix (what Procurement needs)
   - For pilots <= 3 months: IT/Platform approval + Procurement PO approved by BU procurement manager
   - For conversion to 12+ months: CFO signoff required (per Redwood marketplace ops for deals > $250k ARR equivalent)

3) Evidence pack needed for Security review
   - We'll provide a SOC 2 snapshot, short data residency statement, and an infra/VPC diagram. Marcus will attach the VPC network diagram and point to the SOC summary.

4) Co-sell / Marketplace incentives
   - We can surface potential co-sell credit eligibility; that requires registration in AWS Seller Central and a co-sell plan. Vanessa will confirm the take-rate guidance and whether we can include a co-sell credit line item on the offer.

Next steps: Vanessa — can you confirm the Seller Central checklist, HubSpot deal/task to attach to the private offer, and a DocuSign/PO template we can send to Nova? Marcus — can you attach the SOC2 snapshot and VPC diagram so Alicia's security team can start review? Alicia — if you can share Paul Tan (procurement) contact details we’ll include him in the MAP and PO draft.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
VP, Field Sales — Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novacorp.com>, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot activation & PO gating for NovaCorp multi-division pilot

Hi Alicia / team — I'll take point on the marketplace activation. Quick checklist and timeline so we can align procurement/legal this week: 

AWS Marketplace Private Offer checklist (seller ops):
- Confirm Seller Central listing ID (we'll tie the PO to the listing)
- HubSpot deal record created and linked to the private offer (I created draft: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/12345)
- Evidence pack: SOC2 summary, data flow & VPC diagram, minimal DPA language. I'll attach SOC2-snapshot.pdf and network-diagram-vpc.png.
- PO template: I'll attach po-template-novacorp.docx with fields for pilot vs conversion dates and proration lines.
- Co-sell credit: AWS requires co-sell plan registration + partner ops approval. If NovaCorp wants co-sell credit, we need the AWS opportunity registration and a short co-sell one-pager. Co-sell credit is handled separately from the private offer markup; we'll include a line item in the MAP but the fiscal credit runs through Partner/Seller Central workflows.

Buyer approval guidance (customized for multi-division pilots):
- Phase 1 (pilot activation): Procurement PO (BU procurement approver) + Security sign-off (InfoSec acceptance of evidence pack).
- Phase 2 (conversion to 12 months): Deal requires CFO or procurement head signoff; finance will also confirm billing/seat-counting mechanism for usage commits.

DocuSign & MAP
- I'll generate a mutual action plan (NovaCorp-MAP.xlsx) and a DocuSign stub for signature. Link: https://docusign.example.com/doc/ABC123

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot.pdf, network-diagram-vpc.png, po-template-novacorp.docx, NovaCorp-MAP.xlsx

Marissa — please note: if NovaCorp requests any term exceptions (e.g., conversion proration outside standard windows) we'll need legal signoff and to record the exception in our internal market-place exceptions log.

Alicia — once you confirm Paul's email for procurement I'll send the PO draft and MAP; can we aim to have security review comments by EOD Thursday so we can create the private offer Friday?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Marketplace Partnerships — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novacorp.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Paul Tan <paul.tan@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot activation & PO gating for NovaCorp multi-division pilot

Thanks Vanessa & Sean — this looks good. Paul (procurement) is looped here. A few quick confirmations from our side: 

- Pilot term: 3 months start date Dec 15, 2026. Conversion to 12 months will be optional and exercisable within 10 days of pilot end. We prefer automatic proration at conversion (credit applied to first invoice).
- Evidence pack: thanks for the SOC snapshot and VPC diagram — our security team will review and revert with comments by Thursday EOD as requested.
- PO template: we'll use the attached and route for internal BU approval. Paul, please confirm whether we need CFO signoff on a 12-month conversion; otherwise procurement will sign the pilot PO.
- Co-sell credit: NovaCorp is open to pursuing AWS co-sell registration; can Redwood provide the co-sell one-pager and the next steps to get the opportunity registered? We may ask for a modest promotional credit — are you able to include a 2% marketplace credit line to account for joint GTM?

Attachments (from NovaCorp): procurement_contact_v1.vcf (Paul Tan), novacorp-internal-approval-matrix.pdf

Once security signs off we'll be ready to receive the private offer. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alicia Moreno
Head of Platform Integrations, NovaCorp
Alicia.Moreno@novacorp.com
